items.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in New York City filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m extremely pleased to have Annie Ross with me this evening. [INTERVIEWEE] I’m happy to be here.

ctx.x: Vocalist Annie Ross was born in London, England in 1930. She has had an active and successful career in Europe and America and has shared the stage with some of the greatest artists in jazz. With Lambert, Hendricks & Ross, she helped bring vocal jazz to new heights and set the standard for all vocal groups to come. Annie continues to perform as a soloist, and on occasion with her old bandmate Jon Hendricks.
Annie was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
